about.hero.title: Watches with judgment, since 2016
about.hero.subtitle: TimeCraft was born from a shared obsession with precision mechanics and timeless design. Today we source, verify and stand behind every sale, from an entry-level automatic to the rarest vintage find.
about.story.title: A small team, obsessed with the details
about.story.p1: It started in a 30-square-metre workshop, with a loupe, a strap press and the conviction that buying a pre-owned watch shouldn't have to be a leap of faith.
about.story.p2: We're still a small team on purpose: every piece you see on the site has passed through our hands, been photographed by us, and can be vouched for on a direct call — no middlemen, no customer service department.

about.process.title: Four steps, no surprises
about.process.subtitle: The same careful process for a €250 Seiko as for a twenty-thousand-euro vintage Rolex.
about.process.01.title: Explore the collection
about.process.01.body: Filter by brand, price, condition or materials until you find the piece you had in mind — new or vintage.
about.process.02.title: Atelier verification
about.process.02.body: Every watch goes through our authentication process: movement, case, dial and paperwork, checked by hand.
about.process.03.title: We talk on WhatsApp
about.process.03.body: No forms, no carts: you message us, we answer your questions and close the details of the sale directly.
about.process.04.title: Insured delivery
about.process.04.body: We prepare and insure the shipment. You have 14 days from delivery to decide if you're keeping the piece.
about.values.title: What guides us
about.values.authenticity.title: Authenticity first
about.values.authenticity.body: Every piece goes through our atelier's verification process before it's ever listed.
about.values.curation.title: Careful curation
about.values.curation.body: We don't list everything that comes in — we choose pieces with clean provenance and honest condition.
about.values.service.title: Direct service
about.values.service.body: We talk to you on WhatsApp, no endless forms or automated replies.
about.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
about.faq.q1: How do I buy a watch?
about.faq.a1: Pick the model you're interested in and tap "Ask on WhatsApp". A member of our team will help you directly to answer questions and close the sale.
about.faq.a2: Yes. Every piece, new or vintage, goes through an authentication process in our atelier before it's listed on the site.
about.faq.a3: You have 14 days from delivery to return the piece if it doesn't meet your expectations, in the same condition it was delivered in.
about.faq.q4: What's the difference between "available" and "under reserve"?
about.faq.a4: "Available" means the piece is ready to ship. "Under reserve" means it's in final verification or awaiting stock confirmation — ask us and we'll give you an exact timeline.
about.faq.q5: How is the condition of vintage pieces graded?
about.faq.a5: We describe wear, any servicing performed, and the state of the crystal, case and bracelet in detail on every product page. If in doubt, ask us for extra photos on WhatsApp.
about.faq.a6: Yes, we ship across the EU with insurance included. Message us to confirm timing and cost to your destination.
